description: Ministry of Transportation (MOT) Railroad Crossing is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Construction and Maintenance. A Railroad Crossing is where the road surface is common to both the Railway Authority and the Ministry of Transportation Road Network; also includes overhead and under passes. It is a Point feature. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Construction and Maintenance. Its tags are MOT, MOT asset, MOT inventory, RRX, railroad crossing. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
